reason: A DSH plugin for bidirectional Slack collaboration, providing tools to send messages, list channels, receive messages through Socket Mode, and reply in threads.

summaries.zh: 通过 Slack API 和 Socket Mode 为智能体提供双向协作能力，包括发送消息、列出频道、接收消息和线程回复。
summaries.en: Provides agents with two-way Slack collaboration through the Slack API and Socket Mode, including channel listing, message sending, inbox retrieval, and threaded replies.

capabilities: Sends messages to Slack channels and threads
Reads Slack messages through Socket Mode into an in-memory inbox
Replies to Slack messages in threads
Uses Slack bot and app-level tokens
Maintains a network connection to Slack
